_doc: Graded natural-language instructions for the instruction-steerability probe (steer.paper.instr_steer). Fixed 2026-10-11 16:30 PDT BEFORE any render. Requested z -> intensity: -2 = much less, -1 = slightly less, +1 = slightly more, +2 = much more (sign follows the SteerTTS control dim, see steer/config.py). Each phrase completes both '<Name> speaks ...' (Parler-TTS description) and 'Speak ...' (CosyVoice2 instruct2).

loud.-2: much more quietly than usual, almost softly
loud.2: much louder than usual, projecting the voice

f0_med.-2: in a much lower-pitched voice than usual
f0_med.-1: in a slightly lower-pitched voice than usual
f0_med.1: in a slightly higher-pitched voice than usual
f0_med.2: in a much higher-pitched voice than usual

f0_iqr.-2: in a very monotone, flat intonation
f0_iqr.-1: in a slightly more monotone intonation
f0_iqr.1: slightly more expressively, with a bit more pitch variation
f0_iqr.2: in a very expressive and animated way, with a wide pitch range

f0_end.-2: ending the sentence with a strongly falling pitch, like a firm statement
f0_end.-1: ending the sentence with a slightly falling pitch
f0_end.1: ending the sentence with a slightly rising pitch
f0_end.2: ending the sentence with a strongly rising pitch, like a question

pause.-2: without any pauses, in one continuous flow
pause.-1: with slightly fewer pauses than usual
pause.1: with a few more pauses between phrases than usual
pause.2: with many long pauses between words and phrases

tilt.-2: with a much darker, warmer, bass-heavy voice
tilt.-1: with a slightly darker, warmer voice
tilt.2: with a much brighter, sharper, treble-heavy voice

voiced.1: with a slightly fuller, more fully voiced sound
voiced.2: with a full, fully voiced, resonant sound and no whispering at all

flat.-2: with a very pure, clean tone and no airiness at all
flat.-1: with a slightly purer, cleaner tone
flat.1: with a slightly airier, hissier voice
flat.2: with a very airy, hissy, noisy voice

centroid.-1: with slightly softer, more muffled articulation
centroid.2: with very crisp, sharp, precise articulation

cpps.-2: with a very rough, hoarse voice
cpps.-1: with a slightly rougher, hoarser voice
cpps.1: with a slightly clearer, more resonant voice
cpps.2: with a very clear, ringing, resonant voice

h1h2.-2: with a very pressed, tense, strained voice
h1h2.-1: with a slightly more pressed, tense voice

parler_mini.baseline: {name} speaks in a very clean, close-sounding recording with almost no background noise.
parler_mini.directed: {name} speaks {phrase}, in a very clean, close-sounding recording with almost no background noise.

cosyvoice2.baseline: Speak in a natural, neutral way.
